page.content:
World football's governing body that owns the World Cup.

How FIFA connects

  • Topic: FIFA World Cup — FIFA organizes the World Cup every four years.
  • Character: Jules Rimet — Jules Rimet was the FIFA president who made the World Cup real.
  • Character: João Havelange — João Havelange ran FIFA through the television-era World Cups.
  • Character: Gianni Infantino — Gianni Infantino is the FIFA president of the Qatar 2022 era.

What is FIFA?

FIFA — the Fédération Internationale de Football Association — organizes the World Cup, sets the qualifying paths, and awards the trophy that national teams spend four years chasing.

Key threads lead to FIFA World Cup, Jules Rimet, João Havelange and Gianni Infantino.
